1) Liability sequencing: we want a clear statement of which party is responsible for pass-through billing/resale tax audit costs if an end-customer audit occurs.
2) Procurement gating: our finance team requires an evidence matrix (SOC2 + invoice routing examples + revshare waterfall) to be attached to the signed order form.

I've attached the partner paper redline (v2) that captures our proposed carveouts. Can your team confirm which of these are standard for Redwood Dedicated customers vs. Private deployments? Also, if you could provide a short list of the minimum evidence files we should upload to the procurement system, that would help move this along.

Michael —

Thanks for sending. We're aligned that procurement will need a concise evidence bundle and a single-paragraph statement we can put in the order form regarding liability sequencing. Quick answers below and a proposed next step:

- Liability sequencing: Redwood's standard is to absorb platform-level operational costs (e.g., serving runtime incidents) but pass-through costs tied to third-party billing reconciliation (marketplace fee pass-through, tax withholding assessments) are typically the reseller's responsibility unless we explicitly agree otherwise. We can provide a short, neutral paragraph for the order form that outlines that allocation and triggers an audit coordination workflow.

- Private deployments / VPC: For on-prem/Private the customer retains more direct control over logging and KMS; we still recommend a carveout for any third-party marketplace fees and tax pass-throughs.

Next step: Marissa, can you take Michael's redline and produce a one-page evidence checklist (SOC2 link, sample invoice trace, revshare waterfall diagram) + suggested one-paragraph order form language? Ben, please look for any commercial exceptions that would require escalation to Legal (Rishi).

If we can get that by EOD tomorrow we can send OliveCloud a single zip for procurement.

Thanks —
Laura

Michael — thanks for the patience. Laura and Marissa's notes are spot on. I've attached a short commercial redline and an internal runbook for how Redwood typically handles these procurement requests. Key points up front:

1) We will provide the evidence bundle Marissa assembled (SOC2 + invoice example + revshare waterfall) as a single zip for procurement.
2) Proposed order-form snippet (approved by Partnerships): "Liability sequencing: each party will bear costs it directly incurs arising from its contractual obligations; marketplace pass-through charges, third-party tax assessments, and reseller-specific audit remediation costs will default to the reseller unless otherwise agreed in writing."
3) Any carveouts that increase Redwood's exposure beyond platform operational costs (e.g., indemnity for reseller tax liabilities) require Legal review and explicit sign-off (Rishi, tagging you).

Rishi — please confirm whether the snippet above needs material edits from a legal risk perspective. If you OK this, we'll bundle and send to OliveCloud procurement with an Ask: signature + SOW attachment and a DocuSign link.

Attaches: olivecloud_partner_paper_redline_v2.docx (commercial redline)
